title: ATTEST (adapter → runner)
description: A deliver adapter's three-way verdict on one delivery after re-reading what the target stored (SPEC.md §5, §6, §8; ADR-036). Emitted only by adapters declaring `attests` in their manifest, after the RECORD that acknowledges the delivery. `confirmed`: every non-blank field sent is present in what is stored. `contradicted`: a readable value says it did not persist — the record fails, the deliveries row is kept with that status (the record exists at the target; re-sending would duplicate it). `inconclusive`: the re-read failed or the shape was unrecognised — the record advances, `accepted`, with a receipt warning. An attesting adapter that says nothing about a record is `inconclusive`. Runners that predate this message ignore it (§5 forward compatibility).

reason.description: What was compared, or why nothing could be. Omitted when empty.
